name: delete_entry
description: Deletes an Entry from a custom Entry Group or Context Set in Knowledge Catalog.

name.description: Required. Full resource name of the Entry to delete: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group}/entries/{entry_id}` Example for an Entry inside a Context Set: `projects/my-proj/locations/us-central1/entryGroups/my-context-set/entries/documents/concepts`
